description: Freshwater Atlas - Glaciers is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Glaciers and ice masses for the province, derived from aerial imagery flown in the late 1980s and early 1990s. Please refer to the Glaciers dataset for recent glacier extents in British Columbia, and Historical Glaciers for a comparable historic view. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are CWB, corporate watershed base, freshwater atlas. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, KML, MULTIPLE, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
